notes: Names, types, ranges, groups (PG_*) and enum members are parsed from firmware source — Betaflight has no separate parameter metadata artifact.
Entries are the union of all build options: a parameter guarded by #ifdef may be absent from a specific firmware build.
default is null: settings.c carries no defaults (they live in each PG's pgResetTemplate).
description: Betaflight firmware ships no parameter descriptions; text here is SmartTune's curated set where available, empty otherwise.
unresolved_ref marks enums whose member list is defined outside cli/settings.c — validate() reports them as unverifiable rather than accepting any value.
